request.description: Logs work on an accepted lead. `type`: `call`, `meeting`, `whatsapp`, `email`, `sms` or `note` (a note needs `body`). Calls may carry `outcome` (`connected`, `no_answer`, `busy`, `wrong_number`, `call_back`, `switched_off`), `durationSeconds` and `contactId` (from the contact reveal). `occurredAt` defaults to now, may be backdated up to 30 days and not in the future. Activities cannot be edited. The first call, meeting or message meets the first-contact deadline. A `wrong_number` call marks that unverified number invalid, and the lead is flagged `invalid_number` when no usable mobile is left. The assignment moves to `working`. Partner context, on a lead the firm has accepted. Activities are visible to the firm and to FundenFlo staff, never to other firms.

body.raw:
{
  "type": "call",
  "outcome": "connected",
  "durationSeconds": 340,
  "contactId": "{{contactId}}",
  "body": "Discussed documents; borrower will share bank statements"
}
